headerDisplay: Honeywell Home / Resideo Lyric T6 and T6R. Sign in above; no developer keys are required.

country.title: Resideo account country
country.description: Two-letter country used by your Resideo app account. Used for sign-in.

pollInterval.title: Account refresh interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: One shared poll for all thermostats. Commands also request a server readback.

defaultHold.title: Manual temperature changes
defaultHold.description: Temporary hold lasts until the next scheduled period. An existing permanent hold is preserved.

devices.title: Optional device overrides
devices.description: Leave empty to discover all thermostats. Obtain device IDs with Test connection above. Blank rows are ignored.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Log discovery counts. Credentials, tokens and cloud responses are never logged.
